otp.title: Injira ukoresheje indangamuntu
otp.challenged_uniform: Niba iyo ndangamuntu yanditse kandi ifite nimero ya telefone, kode yoherejwe. Yandike hasi.

session.expiring: Igihe cyawe kirangira mu minota mike. Rangiza iki cyiciro cyangwa wongere winjire.

staff.title: Abakozi
staff.lead: Kora abakozi, ubahe imyanya, kandi ubafunge. Uyobora ikigo cyawe gusa. Kode imwe ikoreshwa rimwe y'umukozi mushya itangwa n'umuyobozi wa kabiri, ntabwo ari wowe.

activation.RELEASED_WAITING_OFFICER: Kode yatanzwe; itegereje ko umukozi akora konti

staff.decisionAuthorityNotice: Ufite ububasha bwo gufata icyemezo ashobora gushyira abakandida ku rutonde no kubemera. Iyi mpano irasuzumwa.

create.title: Kora umukozi
create.badHandle: Koresha inyuguti nto 3 kugeza kuri 64, imibare, utudomo cyangwa utwuzuzo.

created.title: {{handle}} yakozwe
created.body: Itegereje gutangwa n'umuyobozi wa kabiri. Undi muyobozi w'ikigo cyawe agomba gutanga kode yo gukora konti; wowe ntuzayibona.

done.reissue: Gukora konti kwa {{handle}} kwongeye gufungurwa. Undi muyobozi agomba gutanga kode.

assign.title: Guhindura imyanya ya {{handle}}?
assign.consequence: {{handle}} arasohorwa ubu kandi azongera kwinjira afite imyanya mishya.

revoke.title: Gusohora {{handle}} hose?
revoke.body: Ibiganiro byose bifunguye by'uyu mukozi birarangira. Konti ikomeza gukora.

reissue.title: Gusubiza gukora konti ya {{handle}}?
reissue.body: Kode yose yatanzwe ireka gukora. Undi muyobozi agomba gutanga nshya.

refusals.INVALID_HANDLE: Iyo nomero y'umukoresha ntiyemewe. Koresha inyuguti nto 3 kugeza kuri 64, imibare, utudomo cyangwa utwuzuzo.
refusals.NOT_FOUND: Uwo mukozi ntari mu kigo cyawe.
refusals.LAST_ACTIVE_ADMIN: Uyu ni we muyobozi wa nyuma ukora kandi ntashobora guhagarikwa.
refusals.NOT_PENDING_ACTIVATION: Uyu mukozi yamaze gukora konti. Koresha guhagarika cyangwa gutanga umwanya.
refusals.SAME_ADMIN: Wowe wakoze cyangwa wasubije iyi gukora konti, bityo undi muyobozi agomba gutanga kode.
refusals.ALREADY_RELEASED: Kode yamaze gutangwa. Subiza gukora konti ubone indi.
refusals.ACTIVATION_EXPIRED: Igihe cyo gutanga kode cyarangiye. Subiza gukora konti.

release.title: Kode yo gukora konti
release.body: Iyi kode yihe {{handle}} imbonankubone. Ayandika ku rupapuro rwo gukora konti agahitamo ijambobanga rye.
release.onceBody: Iyi kode ntibikwa kandi ntishobora kongera kugaragara. Iyo yatakaye, subiza gukora konti.
release.copyFailed: Gukopera ntibyakunze. Hitamo kode uyikopere n'intoki.
release.sheetNote: Bika uru rupapuro ku buryo bwihariye. Rukora rimwe. Rutwike umukozi amaze gukora konti.

activate.title: Kora konti yawe
activate.lead: Andika nomero y'umukoresha na kode ikoreshwa rimwe wahawe, hanyuma uhitemo ijambobanga.
activate.rejected: Iyo nomero n'iyo kode ntibyemewe. Yigenzure, cyangwa usabe umuyobozi wawe gusubiza gukora konti.
